hinweis: Model class per task. The modell:<class> issue label selects the row; without a label use standard. Check model names with /model in Claude Code and Codex before the competition.

klein.beschreibung: Small, clearly specified change in one or two files

ui.beschreibung: UI the jury sees in the demo

schwer.beschreibung: Hard or unclear: architecture, interface, planning

bugfix.beschreibung: Known bug cause or code against a finished specification

recherche.beschreibung: Read and report only: documentation, data, partner material
